capabilities: store diagrams as SVG or .drawio files
extras: The Usage sections (Add/Insert a New Diagram, Edit an Existing Diagram) have no visible body content; actual instructions may be missing from this README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or edit Draw.io diagrams inside the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin introduces diagrams to Obsidian that can be included within notes or as stand-alone files.

summary: Draw.io diagram plugin that creates and edits diagrams embedded in notes or as standalone .drawio/svg files.
